solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/validate-binary-tree-nodes/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1361. Validate Binary Tree Nodes

You have n binary tree nodes numbered from 0 to n - 1 where node i has two children leftChild[i] and rightChild[i], return true if and only if all the given nodes form exactly one valid binary tree.

If node i has no left child then leftChild[i] will equal -1, similarly for the right child.

Note that the nodes have no values and that we only use the node numbers in this problem.

Example 1:

Input: n = 4, leftChild = [1,-1,3,-1], rightChild = [2,-1,-1,-1]
Output: true

Example 2:

Input: n = 4, leftChild = [1,-1,3,-1], rightChild = [2,3,-1,-1]
Output: false

Example 3:

Input: n = 2, leftChild = [1,0], rightChild = [-1,-1]
Output: false

Constraints:

    n == leftChild.length == rightChild.length
    1 <= n <= 10^4
    -1 <= leftChild[i], rightChild[i] <= n - 1
"""


class Solution:
    def validateBinaryTreeNodes(
        self, n: int, leftChild: List[int], rightChild: List[int]
    ) -> bool:
        # Each node except root has exactly one parent
        parent_count = [0] * n

        for i in range(n):
            left = leftChild[i]
            right = rightChild[i]
            if left != -1:
                parent_count[left] += 1
                if parent_count[left] > 1:
                    return False
            if right != -1:
                parent_count[right] += 1
                if parent_count[right] > 1:
                    return False

        # Find root (node with no parent)
        roots = [i for i in range(n) if parent_count[i] == 0]
        if len(roots) != 1:
            return False

        root = roots[0]

        # Check if all nodes are reachable from root (no disconnected nodes)
        visited = set()
        stack = [root]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if node in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(node)
            left = leftChild[node]
            right = rightChild[node]
            if left != -1:
                stack.append(left)
            if right != -1:
                stack.append(right)

        return len(visited) == n


sol = Solution()

print(sol.validateBinaryTreeNodes(4, [1, -1, 3, -1], [2, -1, -1, -1]))  # true

assert sol.validateBinaryTreeNodes(4, [1, -1, 3, -1], [2, -1, -1, -1]) == True
assert sol.validateBinaryTreeNodes(4, [1, -1, 3, -1], [2, 3, -1, -1]) == False
assert sol.validateBinaryTreeNodes(2, [1, 0], [-1, -1]) == False

assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(1, [-1], [-1]) == True
assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(2, [1, -1], [-1, -1]) == True
assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(3, [1, 2, -1], [-1, -1, -1]) == True
assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(3, [1, -1, -1], [2, -1, -1]) == True
assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(3, [1, 1, -1], [-1, -1, -1]) == False
assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(4, [1, -1, -1, -1], [2, 3, -1, -1]) == True
assert Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(4, [1, -1, -1, -1], [2, 0, -1, -1]) == False
assert (
    Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(5, [1, 2, 3, 4, -1], [-1, -1, -1, -1, -1])
    == True
)
assert (
    Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(5, [1, 2, 3, 4, -1], [-1, -1, -1, 0, -1])
    == False
)
assert (
    Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(6, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, -1], [-1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1])
    == True
)
assert (
    Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(6, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, -1], [-1, -1, -1, -1, 0, -1])
    == False
)
assert (
    Solution().validateBinaryTreeNodes(
        10000, list(range(1, 10000)) + [-1], [-1] * 10000
    )
    == True
)
